title: Deadcode: Latest build now available!
author: silveredge96
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’ve been working on **Deadcode: Burn the System**. You pick one of five heroes, build out their skills, and fight your way through a Comic-Con that’s gone sideways.

I just put up a new build and could use some people to try it. I’ve been working on the combat effects, and I want to know how the fights feel to someone playing for the first time. Do the attacks feel good? Can you tell what’s hitting you when things get crowded?

[Play Deadcode in your browser](https://ragephoenix-inferno-arrow.pages.dev/test/)

Even 10 minutes helps. If something’s confusing or you hit a bug, drop a comment with who you were playing and what happened. And if there’s a hero you actually want to keep playing, I’d love to know which one and why.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/silveredge96 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.
